summary: Iteration 4 - Messagerie sécurisée. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (contacts incl. child filtering, create-thread validation 400/403/404/422, participant-only listing/reading (404 for non-participants), unread counts + read marking, /messages/unread total, append messages, un-assign -> 403 + hidden from list then restored, audit entries thread_create/thread_read/send, 401 unauthenticated). Iteration 3 regression suite 15/15 pass. Frontend: educator opens seeded th_seed_leo, replies, filter tabs, new-thread form (link checkbox default on, chips filtered to Léo-access users, submit disabled w/o recipient) creates thread shown in list; admin badge shown (3) and cleared after opening the thread; internal user sees /messages, no threads, no link-child checkbox; /admin, /enfants, overview load.

minor.issue: Each 10s poll of an open conversation writes a 'message.thread_read' audit entry -> audit log flooding (~360 entries/hour per open tab), drowning meaningful entries in /admin/audit (limit 200).
N+1: one fetch_child + one count_documents per thread on every call (unread polled every 30s by every client). Fine for MVP, will not scale.

integration_issues.issue: Thread list (left column, unread dots, last_text) is not polled; only the open conversation refreshes every 10s, so new threads/messages in other threads only show after navigation. Also once thread-error is set (e.g. 403 after un-assign) it never clears.

issues: Left sidebar panel renders as an empty card (no child context) - should be hidden or collapsed for internal role
'Messagerie' uses the same Users icon as 'Personnes ressources' - use MessagesSquare for consistency with topnav

action_items: Avoid logging message.thread_read on every 10s poll (e.g. log only when unread>0 / first open, or dedupe per user+thread per N minutes, or add ?poll=1)
Optionally poll the thread list too (or refresh it on the 10s conversation poll) so unread dots/last messages update
Hide the empty left sidebar for internal users on /messages
critical_code_review_comments: thread_for: participant check before child check correctly returns 404 for non-participants, 403 for lost child access - OK
Contacts endpoint excludes email/password_hash - OK; pending/revoked users excluded via status=active - OK
Thread participants are frozen at creation; if a participant is later revoked/deactivated they remain in participant_names (acceptable, but consider showing status)
No delete/archive endpoint for threads; deleting a child leaves linked threads orphaned (they are hidden since fetch_child returns None, but data remains)
flaky_tests: One run had a transient Cloudflare 502 on /api/auth/login coinciding with a backend hot-reload; rerun passed 14/14
seed_data_creation: None persistent. TEST_iter4* threads/messages removed; th_seed_leo last_* fields reset to latest real message; seed_leo assigned restored to ['seed_educ']. Note: the UI test thread was briefly sent to the product-owner admin (user_2ceae8f60edb) and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iter4_messages.py. Test needs AUTH_ENABLED=true and mongo access for cleanup. Login form uses input[type=email]/[type=password] + Enter. Admin unread badge counts all of admin's threads.
